name: Korean tofu soft stew
steps: Fry a spoon of gochujang in a little sesame oil until fragrant.
Pour in water and bring to a simmer.
Slip in spoonfuls of the soft tofu and the sliced courgette.
Simmer 8 minutes, then crack in the egg and let it poach.
Serve the stew with a bowl of warm rice on the side.
